Both paths are in `worker/src/services/ai-dm.ts`, in `askDM` (line 81). I read the doc and grepped the code. I didn't read the function bodies in full.

**Model failure (the call throws)**
- `askDM` first calls `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast` (line 93). It requests `json_object` format, temperature 0.85 and 1024 tokens.
- If that throws, the `catch` at line 115 retries with `@cf/mistral/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2-lora` (line 119).
- If Mistral also throws, the inner `catch (err2)` at line 133 returns `fallbackNarrative(playerAction)` (line 135). That function (line 198) builds a canned `AIDMResponse`.

**Response that isn't valid JSON**
- On success, `askDM` calls `parseAIResponse(rawText, playerAction)` (line 139, defined at 143).
- `parseAIResponse` strips code fences and extracts the first `{…}` block.
- It returns `fallbackNarrative` in three cases:
  - the text is empty (line 146);
  - no JSON object is found, which also logs `console.warn('[parseAIResponse] no JSON object found…')` (lines 162–163);
  - `JSON.parse` throws, caught at lines 192–193.
- When the JSON does parse, it fills a default for every missing field. It also keeps at most 4 `suggestedActions` and 8 `diceRolls`.

**Nuances**
- The Mistral retry only happens when the Llama call throws. If Llama returns text that isn't valid JSON, `parseAIResponse` falls straight to `fallbackNarrative`. Mistral is not tried.
- Text is read from `choices[0].message.content` and from the legacy `response` field.
- `generateQuest`, `generateBackstory` and `generateLevelUpNarrative` have no Mistral retry. Each has a single Llama call with a `catch` (lines 263, 298 and 325) that returns canned text or an empty string. They only read the legacy `response` field, so with llama-3.3 they fall back more often than they should (`bugs.md` B-03).
- Locally, `wrangler dev` without `--remote` stubs the AI, so you'll always get the fallback text.
